headline: Combined Q3 profit of Israel’s top five banks declines 6% to 8.1 billion shekels
summary: The total net profit of Israel’s five largest commercial banks fell 6% year-over-year in the third quarter to 8.1 billion shekels ($2.2 billion), weighed down by lower interest rates and a windfall tax.
why: The top five commercial banks generate the vast majority of Israel's domestic lending and credit liquidity.
